headline: Congress renamed a Los Angeles post office after Korean independence leader Dosan Ahn Chang Ho.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 3500 West 6th Street, Suite 103 in Los Angeles, California, as the Dosan Ahn Chang Ho Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024.
